entries_exits: Keep the original selected short positions and actual entry/exit times. Disable exercise-risk close for conditional attribution; retain research capital rule and flag any early exit.
signals: Past market-implied American-option Greeks at exactly t minus the chosen lag; require valid past and current stock quotes. No same-bar hedge signal.
sizing: Original whole-share rounding, one call plus one put, capital three times initial 100-share stock notional
pricing: Same Bjerksund-Stensland engine, past-only dividend yield and rate, opposite-leg IV or past IV carry. Recompute sequentially on true one-minute observations.
comparison: Compare archived 15m grid/60m hedge/15m lag, new 1m quotes subsampled to 15m, and the full 1m grid. Disclose any historical quote revisions and Greek-carry differences.
sessions: NYSE regular sessions only; no overnight hedges. Finer regular-hours hedging cannot eliminate overnight jumps.
limits: A 1-minute grid, 1-minute signal delay and whole shares are not literal continuous hedging. No interpolation or simulated sub-minute prices. Snapshot tick freshness and actual assignment remain unobserved.
study_status: Conditional diagnostics on three previously inspected losing trades, not a fresh strategy profitability test
purchase_policy: Use existing authenticated entitlement only; no subscription upgrades or purchases
